messages:
Kami Lin: Hi everyone 44b Im Kami, starting today on Eng-Platform (mostly infra and runtimes). Im based in London (GMT) so I917 will be remote most weeks but planning a SF visit in a month. Fun facts: climber, terrible at sourdough, allergic to peanuts 932, and I bring a philodendron that needs sunlight. Any tips about desks/chairs and snacks?
Ben Rogers: Welcome Kami!! :tada: We have adjustable chairs you can request from facilities, ping me and I44d can reserve one for the first week. Also badge lockers are in row D, combo starts with 3.
Maya Patel: Hi Kami 44b Welcome! For snacks: theres always a gluten+peanut-free shelf in the kitchen labeled GF. We usually put a note on shared treats if someones allergic 64f. Also climbing meetup on Wednesdays 6:30pm at Mission Cliffs if youre into bouldering.
Kami Lin: Thanks Ben 60a I44d will DM you about the chair. Maya 60a Im keen on bouldering! Is that an all-levels group? Also I914 whats the protocol for bringing plants to desks (small philodendron)?
Taylor Gomez: Welcome!! The climbing group is chill, beginners very much welcome. For plants, just label with your name and water needs. Rooftop gets hot in summer so we put sensitive plants up there early AM.
HR-bot: Reminder: submit any dietary restrictions via the onboarding checklist so we can flag communal food vendors. Link: https://intranet/restricted-diet (auto-reminder).
Kami Lin: Filed the dietary form 4dd Thanks everyone. One small silly question 609: is it socially acceptable to bring freshly-baked cookies if I make them gluten-free and peanut-free? Asking for science.
Ben Rogers: Absolutely yes :cookie: Just slap a label GL+PF and maybe keep a small tin on the 2nd floor table. Also FYI badge locker D-20 tends to be free if D-14 is taken.
Maya Patel: :cookie: vote from me. Also if youre on GMT we usually have a 9am-standups that are friendly to EMEA folks; some teams call it "late-late coffee".
welcome-bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires: "Say hi to Kami Lin 44b 3d73fb - Eng-Platform - London (GMT)"
Kami Lin: Thanks!! Looking forward to the chair, the climb, and the cookie experiment 60b See you around (virtually for now) \u2014 Kami
